Call KUSUM HARISH DHARAMSHI first about the HD Fire Protect Limited IPO. The filing shows ₹468.85 Cr in cash in hand from the offer for sale, though the listing notice has not yet been seen. Listing was due 21 Oct 2026, so confirm the event and payment.

Kusum also holds 13,939,200 shares that remain locked in. There is no cash from those shares yet.

HARISH NARSHI DHARAMSHI is linked to ₹243.46 Cr in the findings. The household link is unsure: it was inferred from the printed names and should be confirmed with the client. Their total household wealth is not known.

Ask Kusum how the IPO went and whether a conversation about their plans would be useful.
